item.title: Sen. John Fetterman says it's "entirely possible" Democrats take back Senate
item.description: Democratic Sen. John Fetterman of Pennsylvania said that it's "entirely possible" his party wins control of the Senate in the midterm elections, while leaving the door open on his own political future.

item.title: Hurricane Polo is a strong Category 3 storm off Mexico. See its path.
item.description: Hurricane Polo was downgraded to Category 3 status Saturday as its intensity fluctuated off Mexico's southwestern coast, but it was forecast to make landfall in Baja California on Monday.

item.title: Rep. Jim Himes says the "the Iranians now, in some sense, control what happens on Election Day"
item.description: Democratic Rep. Jim Himes of Connecticut told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that as President Trump rejected Iran's latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and restart talks, "the Iranians now, in some sense, control what happens on Election Day."

item.title: Sen. Kennedy urges Trump to focus on affordability, address nation on Iran ahead of midterms
item.description: Republican Sen. John Kennedy of Louisiana told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that voters are "worried about the cost of living" heading into the midterm elections, and he urged President Trump to focus on that and give a national address amid the war with Iran.

item.title: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian on releasing Americans determined to be wrongfully detained
item.description: In an interview with Margaret Brennan that was taped Friday, Brennan asked Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian about whether he would release the Americans who have been determined to be wrongfully detained in Iran. Pezeshkian said "we tested it, and it didn't work" in previous deals.

item.description: Zoo Atlanta said giant pandas Ping Ping and Fu Shuang arrived at Hartsfield-Jackson International Airport on Sunday morning.

item.title: 3 killed, 4 others hurt in shooting at "after-hours" spot in Detroit, police say
item.description: Three males are dead and four other people are injured after a shooting at an "after-hours" location in Detroit Sunday morning.

item.title: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian says he is open to allowing nuclear inspectors into country
item.description: In an interview with "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" on Friday, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said that he is open to allowing international nuclear inspectors into Iran but not under the "existing framework" set up since the U.S. withdrew from the 2015 nuclear deal.

item.title: Taiwan's representative says the U.S. "made it very clear" there's no change in their position
item.description: Ambassador Alexander Yui, Taiwan's representative to the U.S., told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that amid the recent state visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping, the U.S. "made it very clear there's no change in Taiwan's position for the United States."
